_comment: Defects in the FROZEN catalog data that cannot be fixed in place.
sources/ is hash-pinned by MANIFEST.json; editing a record there would break
verify:sources and destroy the property that makes the freeze worth having. So a
known defect is recorded here instead, and check:citations treats it as expected
rather than failing the build forever. A guard that is permanently red gets
ignored, which is worse than no guard.
Two rules keep this from becoming a place where problems go to be forgotten:
an entry without a reason fails, and an entry that no longer matches a real
problem fails as stale. The allowlist cannot outlive the defect it excuses.
Every entry must be fixed during the Phase 4 catalog import, where records are
read out of sources/ and into the project's own contract.

defects.reason: venue says 'arXiv preprint' but no arxiv_id is supplied, and the paper is NOT on arXiv: three query forms (exact title, title fragment, full-text conjunction) all returned nothing. This is a wrong venue rather than a missing id, and the correct venue is unknown.

venue says 'arXiv preprint' but no arxiv_id is supplied. RESOLVED by search: the paper is arXiv 2603.25770, 'ReCUBE: Evaluating Repository-Level Context Utilization in Code Generation', exact title match. The id is missing, not wrong; supply it at import.

venue says 'arXiv preprint' but no arxiv_id is supplied, and the paper is NOT on arXiv under any of three query forms. Crossref's nearest hit expands 'LLMs' to 'Large Language Models', so a paper of this title plausibly exists elsewhere; the venue claim is wrong either way.
